reason: The README provides sufficient evidence that the plugin’s primary purpose is user-interface enhancement inside the DeepSeek Harness web page, centered on a persistent floating mascot with interactive controls and optional side-panel/chat helper actions; it is best classified as a themes/layout plugin rather than a backend, data-processing, or external integration plugin.

summaries.zh: 该插件是 DeepSeek Harness 网页端的页面内吉祥物扩展，在界面中展示可互动的“鲸鱼娘”角色，并提供右键菜单、拖拽、样式切换和独立解释面板等交互入口。
summaries.en: This plugin is an in-page DeepSeek Harness web UI extension that displays an interactive whale-maid mascot and offers context-menu actions, drag and style interactions, and an explanation panel workflow within the interface.

capabilities: Displays a floating in-page mascot overlay in the DeepSeek Harness web interface.
Supports interactive UI actions such as style switching, dragging, click/hover reactions, and collapse/restore.
Provides right-click menu actions for archiving, creating, and viewing chats, plus a dedicated explanation panel path.
Persists mascot state, visibility, and affinity values in browser localStorage.
Triggers optional task-completion notifications from the web interface.

reasons.code: Repository description and README both explicitly define the plugin as an in-page web UI mascot for DeepSeek Harness, confirming a page-interface purpose.
README documents visual/interaction behavior including floating presence, style switching, drag/inertia animation, and close/restore controls, indicating UI-layout and theme behavior.
README describes chat-related actions (archive/new/drag to archive/delete) and side-panel explanation workflow, which may affect user conversation state.
